sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A note about apparitions in the sunken Valley.
"Apparitions have been sighted in the Guardian Ape of the Sunken Valley's old den. Angry spirits, with many faces. The Guardian Ape's old den can be found at the bottom of the Sunken Valley, not far from the Forest of Mist.
Also, some reported they could hear the sound of a woman crying in the distance..."

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Provides clue about the Shichimen Warrior that appears in the Guardian Ape's Burrow.
To have the Mini-Boss spawn it's necessary to first sever the immortality of the Headless Ape with the Mortal Blade and then enter the Hidden Forest.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Full description can only be read after purchasing the item.
- Carries over to New Game Plus.
